BEFORE YOU COME THROUGH

Good to know.

Where is VZ Clips?

Vaughn is based in Fremont, California. Text (510) 283-7897 for the exact address before your appointment.

What does a haircut cost?

The current men’s haircut is $35 for a 60-minute appointment. Check the booking page for the latest service information.

Can I bring a reference photo?

Absolutely. Bring a photo of the look you have in mind so you and Vaughn can talk through the details.

How do I reschedule?

Use the link in your booking confirmation, or text Vaughn for help with your appointment.
